label.zh-TW: App Store：國泰優惠 CUBE Rewards（條款與隱私網址指向此網域，開發者為國泰金融集團）

intro.zh-TW: 邀請您加入國泰優惠，註冊後可享多重優惠。
intro.en: Join Cathay Rewards (CUBE Rewards) with this invitation and enjoy member offers.

description.zh-TW:
國泰優惠（CUBE Rewards）是提供會員優惠的 App。本站的邀請連結已帶入邀請人的會員編號 BYURAC36，註冊頁可能會自動填入；若沒有，請在對應欄位自行輸入。

邀請內容提到註冊後可享多重優惠，但實際項目、金額與期限以官方公告為準。送出前請確認網址的網域屬於官方，並核對會員編號與本頁顯示的相同。
description.en:
Cathay Rewards (CUBE Rewards) is a member-offers app. The invitation link on this page already contains the inviter's member ID, BYURAC36, so the sign-up page may fill it in automatically; if it does not, enter the ID in the matching field yourself.

The invitation text mentions multiple member offers after you register, but the actual items, amounts and deadlines follow the official announcements. Before you submit, check that the address domain is the platform's official one and that the member ID matches the one shown on this page.

q.zh-TW: 邀請人會員編號要輸入在哪裡？
q.en: Where do I enter the inviter member ID?

a.zh-TW: 使用本頁的邀請連結註冊時，會員編號 BYURAC36 已包含在連結中，註冊頁可能會自動帶入；若欄位是空的，請在對應的邀請欄位手動輸入。
a.en: If you sign up through the invitation link on this page, the member ID BYURAC36 is already part of the link and the sign-up page may fill it in. If the field is empty, enter the ID by hand in the matching invitation field.

q.zh-TW: 會員編號不被接受時怎麼辦？
q.en: What if the member ID is not accepted?

a.zh-TW: 請先核對輸入的內容與本頁顯示的是否一致（留意英文字母與數字），再確認開啟的網址網域屬於官方。若仍不被接受，請依平台目前的公告與規則處理。
a.en: First check that what you entered matches the ID shown on this page, paying attention to letters versus digits, and that the address you opened belongs to the platform's official domain. If it is still rejected, follow the platform's current announcements and rules.
